name: Trucker hat

card.summary: A mesh-back foam-front cap that adds a casual, retro finish to an outfit and shades the face and hairline.
card.aka: Mesh cap, netback cap, gimme cap, feed cap

quick.overview:
The trucker hat is a baseball-style cap with a stiff foam front and plastic mesh back. People wear it as a casual accessory that frames the face, covers a bad hair day and gives outfits a retro or streetwear feel.

It began in the 1970s as a free promotional cap from farm-supply companies, and became a mainstream fashion item in the early 2000s.
quick.how: It is worn as an everyday cap with t-shirts, jackets or streetwear, often with a slogan or logo patch. The adjustable snap back fits most heads, and the mesh keeps the head cooler.
quick.risks: Little risk beyond sun exposure on uncovered ears and neck. Style reception varies; some forum posters treat it as a joke costume piece, others as a deliberate retro look.

lead: A trucker hat, also called a mesh cap, netback cap or gimme cap, is a cap with a stiff foam front and mesh back. People use it as a casual accessory that shades the face and finishes an outfit. [1]

Wikipedia reports that it originated in the 1970s as a promotional giveaway from U.S. feed and farm supply companies to farmers and truck drivers. [1] In the early 2000s it became a mainstream fashion trend among suburban American youth tied to hip-hop, pop punk and skate culture, partly ironic given its blue-collar roots; Pharrell Williams and Ashton Kutcher are credited with helping popularize it. [1]
In forum culture, the hat appears in jokes about a stereotypical rural look, for example a poster listing a mullet, beer and a trucker hat. [2]

angle.text: The hat is a styling accessory that frames the upper face, covers the hair and gives a casual or retro feel, with mesh keeping the head cooler.

infobox: Foam front, mesh back, snap closure

paras: It resembles a baseball cap with a slightly curved bill, six panels and a button, but the front is stiff foam and the rest plastic mesh, making it taller than most baseball caps; a plastic snap or hook-and-loop strap fits most sizes. [1]
Born as a giveaway for rural workers, it was adopted as fashion in the early 2000s. A 2007 King of the Hill episode parodied the trend, and comedian Judah Friedlander is known for slogan hats. [1]
T Nation posters mention trucker hats as part of rural-stereotype jokes. [2]

timeline.event: Feed and farm-supply companies hand out mesh caps as promotions. [1]
Trucker hats become a mainstream fashion trend. [1]
